CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 1
   C. 21
   D. 9

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 17
   C. 25
   D. 27

3. Solve for x: x + 6 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 18

4. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

5. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

7. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 48
   D. 14

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

9. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 65
   C. 64
   D. 16

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 24

12. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

13. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 13
   C. 36
   D. 5

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 82

15. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 28
   C. 29
   D. 11

16. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
